description: Fenniran Penadawn wears a deep green knee-length outer tunic with ornate gold knotwork woven borders over a pale linen undertunic visible at the neckline, cuffs and central front. A richly worked green draped fringed cloak has matching knotwork borders and a round shoulder brooch. A broad decorated brown belt has a large round knotwork medallion buckle, small fittings and a long ornamented hanging strap. Brown trousers and tall brown boots with crossed leather ties complete the outfit. His voluminous curls are uncovered.
